issues.problem: id=lookup is genuinely exclusive to band 1, and id=plain genuinely covers only bands 2 and 4 (with the prose immediately noting that ConnectAsync also repeats band 1 internally). But id=secure, offered as band 3's 'own' program, actually performs and times all four bands (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP) three times per run to build the timing table used later in 'Where the time went'; it is not a program that isolates band 3 the way id=lookup isolates band 1. The framing is defensible (the section's new teaching content is the TLS handshake) but a precise reader comparing it to the id=plain description will notice the asymmetry.
